verdict.rationale: Jan ships a local OpenAI-compatible API server at localhost:1337. Its /v1/chat/completions endpoint supports streaming and tool calling, and an Anthropic-compatible /v1/messages endpoint accepts Anthropic SDK clients. The docs also explicitly advertise connecting Jan with Claude Code, so a coding agent can use Jan as its model backend. Missing for 10: a detailed coding-agent setup guide (Claude Code configuration steps, which local models handle agentic tool use reliably), independent or hands-on corroboration of agent workflows, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404).
